notes.title: Achievement System & More
notes.notes:
[b]Hey folks![/b]

I wanted to take a step back to redo the achievement system to align with an in-game implementation of this system.

Client side achievements don't seem to be working for many of you so I will be sure to fix that first. This being said, the new update will be postponed to later, but this gives us more time to make it even better. I hope this way the wait will be quite worth it.

I want to make the experience the best possible outcome and not rush something last minute just to provide a lousy update. So with that, I hope everyone can sit tight for some time to allow us to make the game much better.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33437046/31d54b5ae6abeb83b94e4ee47e7266a100cced03.png[/img]

- Nyble Team

notes.title: Winterhaven Update
notes.notes:
Hey folks!

We have been hard at work for the last few months to bring you the first big update to the game. In this update we will introduce Winterhaven, a vast ice biome featuring two new bosses and dungeons. Grab your coat, it is going to be a cold one!

Coming this April!

notes.title: Future Patches & More
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We are going to be pushing out a lot of updates in the upcoming year. We are glad this game has recieved a lot of feedback for us to ensure the future of Afelhem is a good one. I will be compiling a list of those updates that you all have provided us with and our own as well. Be sure to head to the discussions to post more to improve  your overall experience with the game.

As always, thank you all for the continued support and happy holidays!

- Nyble Team

notes.title: Afelhem Leaves Early Access!
notes.notes:
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33437046/a0a3802558933ed7777024ac61157a812c883060.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33437046/31d54b5ae6abeb83b94e4ee47e7266a100cced03.png[/img][/url]

Huge thanks to everyone who supported the games development. We will still continue to develop the game and make it better. To contribute to game implementations, general suggestions and bug reports, head to the discussions page for Afelhem and make a post!!!

Again, thank you all and we hope you will enjoy the world of Afelhem.

- Nyble Team

notes.title: Release Date Announcement!
notes.notes:
Hey all!

This is just a short announcement about the official release of the game.

December 4, 2018

Thank you to everyone who supported us by providing suggestions, bug reports and many other things that will aid in the growth of the games overall success. We appreciate everyones input and will continue to develop the game endlessly!

Sincerely,

The Nyble Team

notes.title: Patch 0.5.1: Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
We are aware of many bugs you all found and are hard a work to making sure we patch things up by tonight! In the meantime, we hope you enjoy what we have in store for this Friday! Lots of balancing for items will be worked on as well.

Please visit our discussions page to let us know about anything from bugs to general suggestions! 

- Nyble Team

notes.title: WE ARE LIVE!!!!!!!!!
notes.notes:
We are super excited to bring our game to the Steam platform and really hope you enjoy the game as we continue to develop and improve it along the way to full release! 

We want to give a huge thanks to everyone who has been a part of our development from the beginning and the Steam community for welcoming our game to their lives.

Again, thank you all!

- Nyble Team

notes.title: Update 2: Release Date
notes.notes:
Hey folks!

We will be going live on October 31, 2018 (Halloween)! I hope everyone will find our first release to be enjoyable.

Cheers!

- Nyble Team

notes.title: Update 1: Welcome to Afelhem
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

I would like to welcome everyone and thank you all for your interest in the game. We will be giving out beta access for people to try out the game once we roll out of pre-alpha! Feedback is always appriciated and we would love to hear your suggestions on what you would like to see implemented into Afelhem. 

For more information about the game or to send us your comments, please check out the community hub and feel free to email us at afelhem@hotmail.com. We look forward to making this game exactly how this community desires!

Again, thank you all and we hope to grow with this community to make this a wonderful experience for everyone.

- Nyble Team
